'''Ryan Sutilla''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2000 Menomonee Falls tournament]] in September 2000 with Stormtroopers on Bespin, according to Bryan Prittie's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1208">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-09-big-floppy-donkey-d-ck-men-falls-wid1208/ big-floppy-donkey-d-ck-men-falls-wi], DeckTech (Bryan "DMX" Prittie, 9 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-09-big-floppy-donkey-d-ck-men-falls-wid1208/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
